commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Mario Melero Lopez has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+11' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) says more than he should have to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
90+9' Was it necessary? Kike Garcia (Alaves) is shown a second yellow card for dissent and has to leave the pitch. Mario Melero Lopez had no hesitation in issuing a red card!
90+9' The main referee, Mario Melero Lopez, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Kike Garcia (Alaves) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+8' Alaves have a corner.
90+8' Joan Jordan (Alaves) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort. Alaves have a corner.

90+7' 2 - 3 A good lofted pass from Abdel Abqar finds Kike Garcia (Alaves) on the edge of the area. He collects the ball and rips in a wonderful shot which ends up inside the right post. The score is now 2:3.
90+6' Kike Perez (Valladolid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+4' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) sees a yellow card from Mario Melero Lopez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+4' Raul Moro (Valladolid) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
90+3' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
90+2' Rough tackle by Asier Villalibre (Alaves). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
89' It will be a substitution. Stanko Juric (Valladolid) is ready to enter the pitch as Anuar walks off.

89' Anuar (Valladolid) climbs highest in the middle of the box after a cross from the wing, but sends a good looking header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
88' Joan Jordan (Alaves) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
87' Mario Melero Lopez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid).
84' Paulo Pezzolano has decided to make a change. Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) replaces Mamadou Sylla.
82' Valladolid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
81' Referee Mario Melero Lopez halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Paulo Pezzolano, then shows him a yellow.
80' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
78' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Mario Melero Lopez lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
77' Substitution. Ander Guevara walks off the pitch and Kike Garcia (Alaves) comes on as a substitute.
76' 1 - 3 Goal - 1:3! Mamadou Sylla tees up Anuar (Valladolid) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Antonio Sivera.
74' Paulo Pezzolano decides to make a substitution. Selim Amallah will be replaced by Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid).
74' Substitution. Javier Sanchez will be replaced by Abdulay Juma Bah (Valladolid).
74' That's the end of the game for Mario Martin, who is replaced by Kike Perez (Valladolid).
74' Here is a change. Toni Martinez is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jon Guridi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Asier Villalibre (Alaves).
72' 1 - 2 Selim Amallah (Valladolid) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Antonio Sivera to move before slotting the ball low into the middle of the goal!
72' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) is going to take the penalty!
71' It’s a PENALTY to Valladolid after the VAR review!

71' There's a break in play and referee Mario Melero Lopez must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Valladolid using VAR. This could be interesting!
70' That looked a certain handball by Jon Guridi (Alaves) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
69' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
68' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) has received a yellow card for his foul.
68' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and Valladolid manage to earn a corner.
66' The corner from Selim Amallah (Valladolid) is intercepted by the defence.
66' Raul Moro (Valladolid) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Valladolid force their opponents to concede a corner.
65' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball is out of play. Valladolid will take a throw-in.
64' Joan Jordan (Alaves) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
62' Joan Jordan (Alaves) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
61' Here comes a substitution. Tomas Conechny is given a rest as he is replaced by Luka Romero (Alaves).
61' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Antonio Blanco and he is replaced by Joan Jordan (Alaves).
59' A pass by Ander Guevara (Alaves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. It's a throw-in for Valladolid.
57' Raul Moro (Valladolid) is booked for saying more than Mario Melero Lopez was willing to tolerate.
55' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) is flagged for offside.
54' Mario Martin (Valladolid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
53' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Alaves due to an offside in the build-up play.
52' Wait! Referee Mario Melero Lopez has indicated he is going to review the Alaves goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

51' Carlos Vicente produces a sweet pass and picks out Jon Guridi (Alaves) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 2:1!
48' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Selim Amallah (Valladolid), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
48' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) is booked by the referee.
48' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick to Valladolid.
47' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Karl Hein comes off his line to gather the ball.
47' Kike Garcia (Alaves) receives a yellow card from Mario Melero Lopez and because it's his second he will have an early bath.
46' The whistle blows and Kike Garcia (Alaves) is booked for an infringement.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Mario Melero Lopez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

45+2' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
45+1' Valladolid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45+1' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. Valladolid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' Mario Martin (Valladolid) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Antonio Sivera makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Good work from Valladolid as they win a corner.
44' Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle. Toni Martinez (Alaves) commits a foul after dangerous play.

41' Mario Martin (Valladolid) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Mario Melero Lopez blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
38' Jon Guridi (Alaves) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
37' What a big chance! Manu Sanchez (Alaves) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The game is interrupted as Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) is flagged offside.
35' Jon Guridi (Alaves) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom left corner is denied by a decent save from Karl Hein.
35' The resulting corner, taken by Manu Sanchez (Alaves), comes to nothing.
34' An attempted cross from Tomas Conechny (Alaves) is cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Alaves.
32' 2:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
30' Mario Melero Lopez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Manu Sanchez (Alaves) and blew his whistle.

28' Eray Comert (Valladolid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
26' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) commits a rough challenge and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Referee Mario Melero Lopez sees the trip by Mario Martin (Valladolid) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
21' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
20' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
18' Anuar (Valladolid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
17' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Antonio Sivera no chance!
17' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
16' Anuar (Valladolid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
15' Mario Melero Lopez blows the whistle, Antonio Sivera (Alaves) is penalised for a foul. No point in arguing there. Valladolid will take a penalty kick.
13' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes the corner which is cleared.
11' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) releases a promising shot from the set piece low towards the middle of the target, but Karl Hein makes a save to deny him.
10' Raul Chasco Ruiz (Valladolid) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Alaves have a free kick.
8' Luis Perez (Valladolid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball.

6' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Toni Martinez (Alaves) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Karl Hein just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
5' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

3' Toni Martinez (Alaves) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Valladolid will kick-off.
Mario Melero Lopez was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
